name: @burdenoff/adaptercloud-mcp

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_login
tools.description: Start the device code login flow. Returns a verification URL and user code immediately (non-blocking). The user must open the URL in a browser and enter the code, then call vibecontrols_auth_complete to finish.

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_complete
tools.description: Check if the user has completed the device code authorization in their browser. Call this after the user has opened the verification URL and entered the code from vibecontrols_auth_login. Returns "pending" if not yet authorized, "authenticated" on success.

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_select_workspace
tools.description: Select a workspace after login (when multiple workspaces are available). Issues a workspace-scoped token.

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_workspaces
tools.description: List all workspaces available to the authenticated user.

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_status
tools.description: Show current authentication status including method, token expiration, workspace info, and pending login state.

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_logout
tools.description: Log out and clear all stored authentication tokens.

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_sign_up
tools.description: Register a new account via email/username/password and immediately sign in. Persists access + refresh tokens. Returns { user, accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }.

email.description: Email address for the new account

password.description: Password (caller is responsible for strength policy)

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_sign_in
tools.description: Sign in with username + password (server-side credential flow, distinct from the device-code `auth_login`). Persists access + refresh tokens. Returns { user, accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }.

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_refresh_token
tools.description: Exchange the stored refreshToken for a fresh access + refresh pair. The gql client auto-refreshes when tokens are near expiry; use this tool only when you need to force a refresh now. Persists new tokens. Returns the new { accessToken, expiresIn }.

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_get_current_user
tools.description: Fetch the authenticated user via the SDK `me` query (id, email, username, isActive, emailVerified). Lighter than auth_profile_get and matches the SDK shape. Use auth_status to check authentication state locally without a network round-trip.

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_authenticate_app
tools.description: Machine-to-machine auth via the `authenticateApp` GraphQL mutation. Pass an OAuth app client_id + client_secret (and optional scopes) to receive an access token; persists token for subsequent calls. Returns { accessToken, tokenType, expiresIn, scopes }.

clientSecret.description: OAuth app clientSecret (shown only once on app creation)

scopes.description: Optional list of scope strings to request

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_login_with_api_key
tools.description: Authenticate with a pre-issued API key (headless service mode). The key is stored locally and sent as `X-API-Key` on every gateway request; no network call is made by this tool. Use auth_status to verify. Returns { status: "authenticated", method: "api_key" }.

tools.name: adaptercloud_auth_login_with_client_credentials
tools.description: OAuth2 client_credentials grant (REST against oidcIssuer/token). Equivalent to auth_authenticate_app but uses the OIDC token endpoint instead of the GraphQL mutation; prefer auth_authenticate_app inside the platform. Persists the issued token. Returns { accessToken, expiresIn, scopes }.

tools.name: adaptercloud_adapters_get
tools.description: Fetch a single AdapterCloud adapter (integration definition) by ID, including its connections.

tools.name: adaptercloud_adapters_list
tools.description: List adapters in the bound workspace with optional kind/status filters and pagination. Returns a page envelope { items, pageInfo }.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (PaginationInput.cursor)

tools.name: adaptercloud_adapters_create
tools.description: Register a new adapter (integration definition). `slug` must be unique within the workspace. `configSchema` is an optional JSON Schema describing connection config.

slug.description: URL slug, unique within the workspace

tools.name: adaptercloud_adapters_update
tools.description: Update an adapter. At least one mutable field must be provided. Use `status` to publish/deprecate an adapter.

tools.name: adaptercloud_adapters_archive
tools.description: Archive (soft-delete) an adapter. Returns true on success.

tools.name: adaptercloud_connections_get
tools.description: Fetch a single connection by ID, including its adapter and discovered resources.

tools.name: adaptercloud_connections_list
tools.description: List connections in the bound workspace with optional adapter/status filters and pagination. Returns a page envelope { items, pageInfo }.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (PaginationInput.cursor)

tools.name: adaptercloud_connections_create
tools.description: Create a connection to a target system for an adapter. `config` holds non-secret connection settings; secrets are referenced by `secretRef`.

secretRef.description: Reference to a stored secret (not the secret)

targetRef.description: Opaque reference to the target system

tools.name: adaptercloud_connections_update
tools.description: Update a connection. At least one mutable field must be provided. To change health/lifecycle status use connections_set_status instead.

tools.name: adaptercloud_connections_disable
tools.description: Disable a connection (stops future syncs). Returns the updated connection.

tools.name: adaptercloud_connections_set_status
tools.description: Transition a connection's health/lifecycle status (validated against the connection lifecycle): PENDING, CONNECTED, DEGRADED, ERROR, DISABLED.

tools.name: adaptercloud_resources_get
tools.description: Fetch a single discovered resource by ID, including its connection and dependency edges.

tools.name: adaptercloud_resources_list
tools.description: List discovered resources with optional connection/resourceType/state filters and pagination. Returns a page envelope { items, pageInfo }.

resourceType.description: Filter by provider resource type, e.g. "aws_instance"

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (PaginationInput.cursor)

tools.name: adaptercloud_resources_register
tools.description: Upsert a discovered resource for a connection (idempotent by externalId). Re-registering the same externalId updates the existing resource.

connectionId.description: Connection the resource was discovered through

tools.name: adaptercloud_topology_list
tools.description: List topology edges (resource relationships), optionally filtered by edge kind and/or a resource ID (edges touching that resource).

resourceId.description: Filter to edges touching this resource

tools.name: adaptercloud_topology_create_edge
tools.description: Create a topology edge between two resources (e.g. DEPENDS_ON, ROUTES_TO, CONTAINS). Set `bidirectional` for symmetric relationships.

bidirectional.description: Whether the edge is symmetric (default false)

tools.name: adaptercloud_policies_get
tools.description: Fetch a single governance policy by ID, including its violations.

tools.name: adaptercloud_policies_list
tools.description: List governance policies with optional kind/isActive filters and pagination. Returns a page envelope { items, pageInfo }.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (PaginationInput.cursor)

tools.name: adaptercloud_policies_create
tools.description: Create a governance policy. `expression` is the required policy-rule JSON; `appliesTo` is an optional list of resource-type selectors.

appliesTo.description: Resource-type selectors the policy applies to

isActive.description: Whether the policy is active (default true)

tools.name: adaptercloud_policies_update
tools.description: Update a governance policy. At least one mutable field must be provided. Use `isActive` to enable/disable a policy.

tools.name: adaptercloud_policies_archive
tools.description: Archive (soft-delete) a governance policy. Returns true on success.

tools.name: adaptercloud_violations_list
tools.description: List policy violations with optional policy/resource/status filters and pagination. Returns a page envelope { items, pageInfo }.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (PaginationInput.cursor)

tools.name: adaptercloud_violations_record
tools.description: Record a policy violation against a resource. `evidence` is optional JSON supporting the finding.

tools.name: adaptercloud_violations_resolve
tools.description: Resolve or waive a violation (validated transition). Waiving (status=WAIVED) requires a `waiverReason`.

waiverReason.description: Reason — required when status is WAIVED

tools.name: adaptercloud_drift_list
tools.description: List configuration-drift records, optionally filtered by resource and/or status. Returns a plain array.

tools.name: adaptercloud_drift_record
tools.description: Record a configuration-drift finding for a resource at a given attribute path, capturing expected vs observed values.

tools.name: adaptercloud_drift_remediate
tools.description: Mark a drift record as remediated. Returns the updated drift record.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sync_get
tools.description: Fetch a single sync run by ID, including its counts and summary.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sync_list
tools.description: List sync runs with optional connection/status filters and pagination. Returns a page envelope { items, pageInfo }.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (PaginationInput.cursor)

tools.name: adaptercloud_sync_start
tools.description: Start a sync run against a connection. `kind` selects DISCOVERY (default), RECONCILE, FULL, or COST_INGEST.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sync_complete
tools.description: Mark a sync run as succeeded, recording its discovered/reconciled/drift/violation counts and a summary.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sync_fail
tools.description: Mark a sync run as failed with an error message.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sync_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight or queued sync run. Returns the updated sync run.

tools.name: adaptercloud_cost_list
tools.description: List all cost records, optionally filtered by connection, resource, and/or service.

tools.name: adaptercloud_cost_summary
tools.description: Aggregate spend grouped by cost service across the workspace, optionally scoped to a single connection.

connectionId.description: Scope the summary to one connection

tools.name: adaptercloud_cost_ingest
tools.description: Ingest a cost record for a service over a billing period. `breakdown` is optional per-line-item JSON.

tools.name: adaptercloud_health
tools.description: Public health probe for the AdapterCloud subgraph (adaHealth). Requires no authentication.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_list
tools.description: List Kubernetes-native sandboxes with optional filters and pagination.

status.description: Filter by status (PENDING, PROVISIONING, RUNNING, STOPPING, STOPPED, EXPIRED, FAILED)

template.description: Filter by template (VIBECONTROLS, AI_BUILDER, WORKFLOW_MULTI_NODE, MISC_SHELL, CUSTOM)

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_get
tools.description: Get a sandbox by its ID.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_create
tools.description: Create a new Kubernetes-native sandbox environment with Kata Containers isolation.

containers.description: Container specifications (uses template defaults if omitted)

templateId.description: Sandbox template config ID to use

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_delete
tools.description: Delete a sandbox and its Kubernetes resources.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_stop
tools.description: Stop a running sandbox.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_start
tools.description: Start a stopped sandbox.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_extend
tools.description: Extend the time-to-live of a sandbox.

additionalSeconds.description: Number of seconds to add to the TTL

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_templates_list
tools.description: List sandbox template configurations available in this workspace.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_templates_get
tools.description: Get a sandbox template by ID.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_templates_create
tools.description: Create a new sandbox template configuration.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_templates_update
tools.description: Update a sandbox template configuration.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_templates_delete
tools.description: Delete a sandbox template configuration.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_tags_list
tools.description: List available sandbox tags in the workspace.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_tags_get
tools.description: Get tag assignments for a sandbox.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_tags_create
tools.description: Create a new sandbox tag.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_tags_attach
tools.description: Attach a tag to a sandbox.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_tags_detach
tools.description: Detach a tag from a sandbox.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_tags_replace
tools.description: Replace the full set of tags on a sandbox.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_admin_list_all
tools.description: Admin-only list across the entire workspace including internal sandboxes.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_admin_nodes_list
tools.description: List Kubernetes nodes hosting sandbox workloads with capacity info.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_admin_active
tools.description: Get currently active sandboxes in the workspace.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_admin_activity
tools.description: Get recent sandbox lifecycle activity (create/stop/delete/extend).

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_admin_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate sandbox usage statistics for the workspace.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_admin_logs
tools.description: Fetch logs for a sandbox container.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_admin_config_get
tools.description: Get the per-workspace sandbox configuration limits.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_admin_config_set
tools.description: Update the per-workspace sandbox configuration limits.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_export_create
tools.description: Kick off an async job to export sandboxes for the workspace.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_export_get
tools.description: Get a sandbox export job by ID. Poll this to track progress (MCP has no subscriptions).

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_export_list
tools.description: List sandbox export jobs for a workspace.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_export_get_artifact_bytes
tools.description: Fetch raw artifact bytes for a sandbox session (base64-encoded, 50 MB cap).

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_proxy_request
tools.description: Proxy an HTTP request to a service running inside a sandbox container.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_check
tools.description: Poll a sandbox by ID. MCP has no subscription protocol — call this in a loop to track lifecycle.

tools.name: adaptercloud_sandbox_export_check
tools.description: Poll an export job by ID. MCP has no subscription protocol — call this in a loop to track progress.

tools.name: adaptercloud_rbac_roles_list
tools.description: List RBAC roles for a workspace or global scope.

tools.name: adaptercloud_rbac_roles_get
tools.description: Get a role by id from the workspace or global layer.

tools.name: adaptercloud_rbac_roles_create
tools.description: Create a new RBAC role at the workspace or global layer.

tools.name: adaptercloud_rbac_roles_update
tools.description: Update an existing role.

tools.name: adaptercloud_rbac_roles_delete
tools.description: Delete a role, optionally reassigning actors to another role.

tools.name: adaptercloud_rbac_policies_list
tools.description: List OPA policy references registered on the chosen gateway (workspace or global), optionally filtered by resource/action/active state. Returns an array of PolicyReference.

tools.name: adaptercloud_rbac_policies_attach
tools.description: Attach an OPA policy reference to a role on the chosen gateway. Returns the attached PolicyReference.

tools.name: adaptercloud_rbac_policies_detach
tools.description: Detach an OPA policy reference from a role on the chosen gateway. Returns { detached: boolean, roleId, policyId }.

tools.name: adaptercloud_rbac_check
tools.description: Check whether an actor has permission for an action on a resource.

tools.name: adaptercloud_organizations_list
tools.description: List organizations the current user is a member of.

tools.name: adaptercloud_organizations_current
tools.description: Return the current organization context from the auth store.

tools.name: adaptercloud_organizations_invites_list
tools.description: List organization invites for the current user.

tools.name: adaptercloud_organizations_invites_accept
tools.description: Accept a pending organization invite.

tools.name: adaptercloud_organizations_invites_decline
tools.description: Decline a pending organization invite.

tools.name: adaptercloud_organizations_get
tools.description: Fetch a single organization by ID. Returns the full organization detail (tenant, slug, status, member/workspace counts).

tools.name: adaptercloud_organizations_members_list
tools.description: List the members of an organization with pagination. Returns { items, total, hasMore, limit, offset }.

tools.name: adaptercloud_organizations_members_invite
tools.description: Send an invitation to join an organization. The invitee receives an email-style invite with the chosen role; returns the created OrganizationInvite.

organizationId.description: Organization ID to invite the user into

role.description: Role to grant on acceptance (defaults to MEMBER)

message.description: Optional message included with the invite

tools.name: adaptercloud_organizations_members_remove
tools.description: Remove a user from an organization. Returns { removed: boolean, organizationId, userId }.

userId.description: User ID to remove from the organization

tools.name: adaptercloud_organizations_members_role
tools.description: Update the role of an existing organization member. Returns the updated OrganizationMember.

userId.description: User ID whose role will change

tools.name: adaptercloud_tours_list
tools.description: List available product tours.

tools.name: adaptercloud_tours_progress_get
tools.description: Get the current user's tour progress, optionally filtered by user id.

tools.name: adaptercloud_tours_complete
tools.description: Mark a tour step as completed for the given user. The user can only complete steps for themselves — the gateway rejects mismatched userId. Returns the updated UserTourProgress.

userId.description: User ID to mark the step completed for (must match the authenticated actor at the gateway)

tools.name: adaptercloud_tours_progress_reset
tools.description: Reset tour progress for the given user (defaults to the current actor).

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_current
tools.description: Inspect the workspace currently bound to this MCP session (workspace ID, organization ID, and whether a workspace token is held).

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_list
tools.description: List workspaces visible to the current actor on the workspace gateway, with optional filters and pagination. Returns { items, total, hasMore }.

status.description: Filter by workspace status (will be uppercased; e.g. ACTIVE|ARCHIVED)

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_get
tools.description: Get a workspace by its ID (global layer).

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_create
tools.description: Create a workspace (global layer).

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_update
tools.description: Update a workspace (global layer). At least one field must be provided.

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_delete
tools.description: Delete a workspace (workspace layer).

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_members_list
tools.description: List members of a workspace.

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_members_add
tools.description: Add a member to a workspace.

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_members_remove
tools.description: Remove a member by membership id.

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_members_role
tools.description: Update a workspace member role.

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_projects_list
tools.description: List projects, optionally filtered by workspace.

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_projects_get
tools.description: Get a project by ID.

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_projects_create
tools.description: Create a project inside a workspace.

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_invites_accept
tools.description: Accept a workspace invitation by invitation ID. Returns { id, status, workspaceId } of the accepted invite.

tools.name: adaptercloud_workspace_activity
tools.description: Workspace activity log (audit events) for a given workspace.

tools.name: adaptercloud_groups_list
tools.description: List groups with optional type/status filters and pagination.

tools.name: adaptercloud_groups_get
tools.description: Get a group by its ID.

tools.name: adaptercloud_groups_create
tools.description: Create a new group.

tools.name: adaptercloud_groups_update
tools.description: Update a group. At least one mutable field must be provided.

tools.name: adaptercloud_groups_delete
tools.description: Delete a group. Use archive=true for a soft delete (status change only).

archive.description: Archive instead of hard delete (default false)

tools.name: adaptercloud_groups_members_list
tools.description: List members of a group.

tools.name: adaptercloud_groups_members_add
tools.description: Add a single member to a group.

tools.name: adaptercloud_groups_members_remove
tools.description: Remove one or more members from a group by membership ID.

tools.name: adaptercloud_groups_hierarchy
tools.description: Show all groups an entity (user/group) belongs to.

tools.name: adaptercloud_groups_activity
tools.description: Audit log for a group.

tools.name: adaptercloud_tags_list
tools.description: List tags in the currently-bound workspace, with optional scope/search filters and pagination. Returns { items, total, hasMore }.

tools.name: adaptercloud_tags_get
tools.description: Fetch a single tag by ID. Returns the full detail shape (color, icon, hierarchy, usage counters).

tools.name: adaptercloud_tags_create
tools.description: Create a tag in the currently-bound workspace. `key` must be unique within the (workspace, scope) tuple; `label` is the human-readable display name.

key.description: Stable identifier (kebab-case recommended); unique within workspace+scope

color.description: Hex color (e.g. #ff8800) — must be a semantic theme token in UI

parentId.description: Parent tag ID for hierarchical taxonomies

tools.name: adaptercloud_tags_update
tools.description: Update a tag. At least one mutable field (label / description / color / icon / parentId / displayOrder) must be provided. The workspace context is implicit.

description.description: Updated description (pass empty string to clear)

displayOrder.description: Updated display order within parent (lower sorts first)

tools.name: adaptercloud_tags_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag and all its assignments. This is destructive — there is no soft-delete on the tags service.

tools.name: adaptercloud_tags_analytics
tools.description: Time-bucketed analytics for a tag: assignmentCount, uniqueUsers, uniqueEntities, and entityType breakdown over the [from, to] window.

from.description: Start of the window in ISO-8601 (DateTime)

to.description: End of the window in ISO-8601 (DateTime)

tools.name: adaptercloud_tags_permissions_list
tools.description: List all tag relations originating from the given tag (synonyms, hierarchy, implies/excludes, etc.).

tools.name: adaptercloud_tags_permissions_grant
tools.description: Create a typed relation between two tags. Set bidirectional=true to mirror the relation in both directions (only meaningful for symmetric types like SYNONYM, ANTONYM, RELATED).

bidirectional.description: Mirror the relation in the reverse direction (default false)

tools.name: adaptercloud_tags_permissions_revoke
tools.description: Delete a tag relation by its relation ID.

tools.name: adaptercloud_files_browse
tools.description: Browse a workspace folder. Returns subfolders and paginated files. Omit folderId to browse the root.

tools.name: adaptercloud_files_upload_initiate
tools.description: Initiate a multipart upload session. Returns presigned URL(s) the caller must PUT bytes to, plus a sessionId to use with files_upload_complete. MCP cannot read local files; the caller is responsible for streaming bytes to the returned URL(s).

sha256Hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file contents

tools.name: adaptercloud_files_upload_complete
tools.description: Complete an in-flight upload session previously initiated by files_upload_initiate.

tools.name: adaptercloud_files_share_create
tools.description: Create a shareable link for a file with optional access controls.

password.description: Optional password to gate the share

tools.name: adaptercloud_files_share_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a previously created file share by ID.

tools.name: adaptercloud_files_list
tools.description: List files in a workspace, optionally scoped to a folder. Returns { files, total, page, limit, hasMore }.

folderId.description: Folder ID (omit to list workspace root)

tools.name: adaptercloud_files_get
tools.description: Get a single file by ID. Returns the file record or an error if not found.

tools.name: adaptercloud_files_download
tools.description: Resolve a server-signed presigned download URL for a file. The MCP cannot stream binary bytes itself; callers must GET the returned URL out-of-band. Returns { url, expiresIn }.

expiresIn.description: URL TTL in seconds (server default applies when omitted)

tools.name: adaptercloud_files_upload
tools.description: Single-shot file upload mirroring the SDK files.upload contract (s3Bucket/s3Key/size pre-resolved). For raw-byte uploads from MCP callers, prefer files_upload_initiate + files_upload_complete which use presigned URLs. Returns the persisted file record.

s3Bucket.description: S3 bucket holding the uploaded object

tools.name: adaptercloud_files_share
tools.description: Create a share for a file (mirrors SDK files.share). Returns the persisted FileShare record.

shareType.description: Share type (PUBLIC_LINK = anonymous, EMAIL_INVITE = by email, GROUP_SHARE = by user IDs)

password.description: Optional password to gate the share

invitedUserIds.description: User IDs to grant access for GROUP_SHARE shares

tools.name: adaptercloud_files_revoke
tools.description: Revoke an existing file share by ID (mirrors SDK files.shareApi.revoke). Returns the updated share record with revokedAt/revokedBy set.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_list
tools.description: List threaded conversations with optional type filter and cursor pagination.

after.description: Cursor returned by a previous page

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_get
tools.description: Get a single conversation by ID.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_create
tools.description: Create a new threaded conversation.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_update
tools.description: Update title and/or description of a conversation.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_delete
tools.description: Delete a conversation by ID.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a conversation. Optionally reply to a parent message.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_list
tools.description: List messages in a conversation with cursor pagination. Returns { items, pageInfo }.

after.description: Cursor returned by a previous page

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_send
tools.description: Send a message to a conversation under the nested messages.send surface. Returns the created Message.

type.description: Message type (default TEXT, will be uppercased)

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_settings_get
tools.description: Fetch the settings JSON for a conversation. Returns { id, settings }; settings is null if the conversation has no overrides.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_settings_set
tools.description: Update the settings (notification level, retention, moderation, etc.) for a conversation. At least one setting field must be provided. Returns the updated conversation { id, settings }.

defaultNotificationLevel.description: Default notification level for new members (ALL/MENTIONS/MUTED)

messageRetentionDays.description: Auto-delete messages older than N days (null = keep forever)

slowModeSeconds.description: Seconds between consecutive messages per user (0 = off)

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_get
tools.description: Fetch a single message by ID.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_edit
tools.description: Edit an existing message. Provide new content (object) and optional reason.

reason.description: Optional reason for the edit (audit log)

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_delete
tools.description: Soft-delete (default) or hard-delete a message.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_forward
tools.description: Forward an existing message into another conversation.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_pin
tools.description: Pin a message to its conversation.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_unpin
tools.description: Remove a pinned message from its conversation.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_hide
tools.description: Moderator action: hide a message with a reason.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_unhide
tools.description: Moderator action: restore a previously hidden message.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_search
tools.description: Full-text search across messages. Optionally scope to a conversation.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_unread
tools.description: List unread messages for the current actor across all conversations.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_messages_report
tools.description: Report a message for moderation review.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_drafts_get
tools.description: Fetch the current actor’s draft for a conversation, if any.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_drafts_save
tools.description: Save (upsert) the current actor’s draft for a conversation.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_drafts_delete
tools.description: Delete the current actor’s draft for a conversation.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_reactions_add
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_reactions_remove
tools.description: Remove the current actor’s emoji reaction from a message.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_threads_get
tools.description: List the replies under a thread-root message.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_get_or_create_direct
tools.description: Open (or create) a 1:1 DM conversation with another user.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_mentions_list
tools.description: List messages that mention the current actor.

tools.name: adaptercloud_conversations_search
